newsitem.title: KENYA: Industrials pull Nairobi bourse index lower.
newsitem.headline: Industrials pull Nairobi bourse index lower.

text.p: Lower prices in industrials saw the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index drop marginally on Wednesday, brokers and bourse officials said.
The index lost 3.05 points to stand at 3,058.52. Turnover was posted at 19.381 million shillings traded on 501,858 shares from 6.654 million shillings traded on 184,634 shares on Wednesday.
Bamburi Cement eased to 28.50 from 29, Kenya Breweries eased to 49.50 from 50 while Kenya National Mills lost a shilling to stand at 49.
Kenya Airways was steady at 9.45 on 47,033 shares while Uchumi Supermarket traded 16,330 shares at 50.
Turnover tripled however, with foreigners buying 285,000 shares of Firestone at 28 on the three-day offer board and a million Uchumi shares at 50.
Nation Printers & Publishers traded 61,062 shares at 108 from 107, while Standard Newspapers Group traded 8,085 shares at 8 unchanged from Tuesday.
